nonstandard_residues: Replaced by X for alignment scoring; excluded from pairwise identity denominator
identity_definition: Identical standard amino-acid pairs divided by comparable aligned standard amino-acid pairs
external_coverage_definition: Jointly aligned extracellular residues divided by all annotated extracellular residues in the relevant species
exact_conservation_definition: Identical jointly aligned standard amino acids divided by all relevant annotated residues
alternative_optimal_alignments: First optimal alignment retained; non-unique solutions flagged
coordinate_convention: Alignment coordinates are zero-based; UniProt segment boundaries are one-based inclusive
